scope: Read-only verification of the current project-owned Domain/OS guest frame and MAME ownership before any further GTK2 horizontal-arrow interaction.

identity.verify_script_reason: A second distinct MAME instance is active; project VM script prohibits graphical input while any other MAME instance is present. Both disk identities matched their own workspaces.

method.capture: Read-only manager.machine.screens[':apollo_screen:screen']:snapshot(path) through the correlated project bridge.

observation.target: A horizontal scrollbar segment is visible at the lower edge of the underlying window; the pointer is elsewhere. No arrow was pressed.

result.classification: current guest frame and separate disk ownership verified; no graphical input permitted by the local VM guard
result.interpretation: This captures the current visible target and prevents repeating the obsolete assumption that the guest is black. It does not prove input delivery, pointer mapping, or pressed-state appearance.

next: Continue independent GTK2 work; resume the horizontal held comparison only after the second MAME is no longer active and the target is still verified in a fresh frame. Do not stop or alter the other VM.
